objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: by (a) it contains a minimal transversal $T$, and $T\in\mathcal C$ by (iii). Since $T$ is finite
objection.witness: At the decisive final application of Zorn, the contained minimal transversal may be infinite. Its finiteness is obtained only by invoking the unproved full self-duality, so the combinatorial theorem cannot validly be applied to the constructed family.
